Introduction nano-graphrag supports four query modes, each optimized for different types of questions: | Mode | Strategy | Best for | |------|----------|----------| | **Global** | Aggregates community reports | Broad thematic questions ("What are the main themes?") | | **Local** | Entity-level retrieval + neighborhood | Specific entity questions ("What is Scrooge's relationship with Bob?") | | **Naive** | Plain vector similarity on chunks | Simple RAG baseline (no graph) | | **Entity-Grounded** | Validated entity-based answers | Precise, factual answers grounded in entities | This notebook demonstrates each mode, compares results, and shows streaming. ## Setup ::: {#setup .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import logging import time from pathlib import Path logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING) logging.getLogger("nano-graphrag").setLevel(logging.INFO) WORKING_DIR = Path("./_cache/03_query_modes") WORKING_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) ``` ::: ::: {#imports .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} from nano_graphrag import GraphRAG, QueryParam from nano_graphrag.base import ResponseType ``` ::: ##
